content.title: About
content.content: Frozen yogurt with chocolate is a frozen dessert made from yogurt base and enriched with dark chocolate pieces or glaze. It combines the light tang of yogurt with the rich flavor of chocolate, offering a creamy texture and lower fat content compared to traditional ice cream.

content.title: Interesting Facts
items: Frozen yogurt originated in the United States in the 1970s as a healthier alternative to ice cream.
Chocolate is often added as chips, a coating, or protein‑rich chocolate balls.
The yogurt base provides probiotics that support gut health.
In Russia, frozen yogurt’s popularity is rising thanks to a wide range of flavors and low calorie count.
The yogurt‑chocolate combo is frequently used in sports nutrition for post‑workout recovery.

items.title: Rich in probiotics
items.content: The yogurt base contains live cultures that help maintain a healthy digestive system.

items.title: Low in fat
items.content: Compared with regular ice cream, frozen yogurt typically contains less fat, making it a lighter dessert option.

items.title: Source of calcium
items.content: Yogurt provides a good amount of calcium, essential for strong bones and teeth.

items.title: Antioxidants from chocolate
items.content: Dark chocolate is high in flavonoids, which help combat oxidative stress.

items.title: Energy support
items.content: The mix of carbohydrates and protein in yogurt offers a quick and sustained energy boost.

items.title: Lactose intolerance
items.content: Yogurt contains lactose, so individuals with intolerance should choose lactose‑free versions.

items.title: Milk protein allergy
items.content: Some people may be allergic to casein or whey proteins present in yogurt.

items.title: Added sugar content
items.content: Certain frozen yogurt products may contain added sugars; checking the label is advisable.

items.title: Caffeine in chocolate
items.content: Dark chocolate contains small amounts of caffeine, which can affect sensitive individuals.

content.title: How to Eat
content.content: The product is sold in single‑serve cups or cones. It can be eaten straight from the container, or topped with fresh berries, nuts, or honey for extra flavor.

content.title: Storage
content.content: Keep frozen yogurt at –18 °C or lower. After opening, consume within 2–3 days, storing it in an airtight container in the freezer to prevent ice crystal formation.
